## What's new

- **Compare two folders.** A new window shows two folders side by side, scene by scene, to help tidy up folders that hold the same videos. Each scene is paired with the one in the other folder it seems to be, going by the screenshots, names, lengths, sizes and dimensions:
  - **Identical file**: the same size and length, even under another name.
  - **Same video**: a close length and alike screenshots, such as a smaller copy of the same video. What differs is listed, and the higher-resolution copy is marked.
  - **Maybe the same**: the same name but a different length, or a similar name and length.
  - **Only on the left** or **Only on the right**: nothing like it in the other folder.
- **Look-alike folders.** Down the side of the window are pairs of folders across the collection with similar names or scenes in common, likeliest first. Pick one to compare them.
- **Ways to open it:** **Collection > Compare Folders...**, **Views > Look-alike folders...**, **Compare with...** on a folder's right-click menu, or **Compare** on the bar when two folders are picked.
- **Tidying up.** Click a screenshot to play the scene, show its file in Explorer, or open either folder in Explorer to move things by hand. Ticked scenes can be deleted, after asking, and **Tick copies on the left** or **on the right** ticks the identical files on one side. Nothing else is changed.
